rows.differenceDescription: Current map, popup, API, SEO, SSOT and wiki-truth records remain comparison-only inputs and were not used to derive the no-unitary-regime conclusion. Повторный аудит: Свежая визуальная перепроверка закрывает AQ жёлтым и не выдаёт Antarctica за единое государство или единый уголовный кодекс. Официальная страница Antarctic Treaty Secretariat прямо говорит, что Parties реализуют Treaty и Environment Protocol через собственные national legislations, а посетители получают разрешения у соответствующих National Competent Authorities. Визуально проверенный Article VIII самого Antarctic Treaty закрепляет национальную юрисдикцию для observers, exchanged scientific personnel и сопровождающего персонала, а споры о юрисдикции для иных случаев решаются консультациями сторон. Одновременно действующий Annex II Article 4 устанавливает общий для Antarctic Treaty area материальный минимум: никакой не местный живой организм нельзя вводить на сушу, ледовые шельфы или в воду без permit; разрешения допускают cultivated plants и reproductive propagules только для controlled use, а living organisms — для controlled experimental use, после чего их требуется удалить или обезвредить. Официальный UNODC Single Convention визуально определяет Cannabis, Cannabis plant и Cannabis resin и показывает международный medical/scientific-only контроль, а актуальный INCB Yellow List визуально включает cannabis и cannabis resin/extracts/tinctures в Schedule I; эти документы используются как прямой cannabis-идентификатор и общий международный контекст, а не как выдуманный единый AQ criminal code. Поэтому для whole-Antarctica нет общего recreational legal market или общего права на выращивание: введение живого cannabis plant permit-only, а медицинское/научное обращение и иные possession/use вопросы зависят от национальной юрисдикции и компетентного органа. В трёхцветной модели такой ограниченный условный режим — жёлтый. Не утверждается, что все национальные режимы одинаковы, что найден единый AQ possession offence, что существует AQ patient programme или что конкретный cannabis medicine доступен. Статус SSOT не изменён.

rows.differenceDescription: UN-hosted material records an NGO description of Bir Tawil as unclaimed territory, while the UN Law of the Sea Bulletin preserves Egypt/Sudan boundary positions; neither is a BRT lawmaker, territorial cannabis statute, or extension rule. Egypt and Sudan access-state law does not become law of BRT merely because those states border the area. The general resolver requires direct territorial applicability before a colour may be derived. BRT remains UNKNOWN for NO_UNITARY_APPLICABLE_REGIME. Повторный аудит: Свежая визуальная перепроверка закрывает BRT жёлтым, не изобретая государство, территориальный уголовный кодекс или CannabisLawPage Bir Tawil. В отчёте Генерального секретаря ООН A/80/304 формулировка unclaimed territory приведена в разделе вкладов неправительственных организаций: это официально опубликованное negative/context evidence, но не обязательное юридическое решение ООН. Официальные заявления Egypt и Sudan, опубликованные в UN Law of the Sea Bulletin No. 94, визуально показывают несовместимые пограничные позиции: Egypt считает международной границей 22-ю параллель и относит территории к югу от неё к Sudan, тогда как Sudan заявляет Hala'ib к северу от 22-й параллели по унаследованной границе. Ни одна из просмотренных государственных веток не публикует орган Bir Tawil, территориальный cannabis-law, полицию, суд или patient programme; частные micronation-декларации поэтому отвергнуты. Для обязательного трёхцветного отображения применяется явно обозначенный operational-access fallback, а не территориальный закон: физический сухопутный доступ возможен только через Egypt или Sudan, и обе реальные CannabisLawPage просмотрены глазами. Egypt EDA публикует Law No. 182/1960 и актуальный индекс поправок до 2020 года; закон помещает Cannabis sativa/Indian hemp в запрещённые к выращиванию растения, запрещает неразрешённые cultivation, import, possession и trade, допускает только лицензируемые medical/scientific операции и предусматривает строгие наказания. Sudan Judiciary на действующем официальном сайте в 2026 году продолжает применять Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act 1994 и его таблицы, включая дела о hashish; визуально проверенная копия UNODC Legal Library определяет hashish как Indian hemp, перечисляет cannabis, cannabis resin и tetrahydrocannabinols, запрещает import, production, possession, transport и trade, оставляя только minister-authorized medical/scientific purposes и строгие уголовные наказания. Поэтому доказанного общего recreational legal market нет, а допустимость ограничена разрешительными медицинскими/научными режимами двух единственных сухопутных access states. В трёхцветной модели это жёлтый: зелёный ложно утверждал бы доказанную легальность, красный ложно приписал бы BRT собственный запрет. Enforcement строг на маршрутах Egypt/Sudan, но отдельной BRT enforcement authority нет. Вывод не распространяет автоматически суверенитет Egypt или Sudan на Bir Tawil, не создаёт BRT patient programme и не меняет статус SSOT.

rows.differenceDescription: Свежая визуальная перепроверка закрывает BV красным без автоматического переноса всего материкового медицинского режима Norway. Bilandsloven визуально подтверждает норвежский суверенитет над Bouvetøya и прямо распространяет на biland норвежское уголовное право. Официальный government analysis Prop. 69 L подтверждает ту же норму: private law, criminal law и law of procedure действуют на bilandene, а специальное законодательство и подзаконные акты требуют отдельного основания. Действующий правительственный cannabis-раздел визуально связывает cannabis с уголовными §§231 и 162: оборот, передача, пересылка, use и possession вне медицинских/научных целей незаконны. Narkotikaforskriften визуально называет Cannabis и Cannabisharpiks и показывает запрет §5, а Penal Code устанавливает строгие сроки за narcotics offences. Но отдельного акта, распространяющего на Bouvetøya материковый patient-access режим legemiddelloven/DMP, не найдено, и национальная medical-cannabis страница не выдаётся за BV-specific право. Поэтому минимально доказанный территориальный режим: recreational запрещён, criminal enforcement строгий, подтверждённого BV medical-cannabis patient pathway нет. В трёхцветной модели это красный; вывод не утверждает, что на необитаемом острове существует абсолютный запрет любой медицинской помощи.

Официальный government analysis Prop. 69 L подтверждает ту же норму: private law, criminal law и law of procedure действуют на bilandene, а специальное законодательство и подзаконные акты требуют отдельного основания. Действующий правительственный cannabis-раздел визуально связывает cannabis с уголовными §§231 и 162: оборот, передача, пересылка, use и possession вне медицинских/научных целей незаконны. Narkotikaforskriften визуально называет Cannabis и Cannabisharpiks и показывает запрет §5, а Penal Code устанавливает строгие сроки за narcotics offences. Но отдельного акта, распространяющего на Bouvetøya материковый patient-access режим legemiddelloven/DMP, не найдено, и национальная medical-cannabis страница не выдаётся за BV-specific право. Поэтому минимально доказанный территориальный режим: recreational запрещён, criminal enforcement строгий, подтверждённого BV medical-cannabis patient pathway нет. В трёхцветной модели это красный; вывод не утверждает, что на необитаемом острове существует абсолютный запрет любой медицинской помощи.

directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.visualReview: Fresh independent review: the current Ministry of Justice consolidated Criminal Code directly penalises unauthorised possession and Cannabis-genus cultivation. The primary State Gazette classification regulation expressly puts cannabis/marijuana in List I, whose heading prohibits human and veterinary medical application. rows.differenceDescription: Independent recheck: Chad Law No. 024/PR/2000 Article 36 adopts ratified international narcotic/psychotropic schedules but delegates possession, prescription and dispensing rules to decrees. The visually reviewed Article 34/36 crop is generic and has no cannabis-specific patient, product, supply or current implementing-decree proof. Article 134 penalizes contravention of regulatory provisions, not cannabis conduct by itself. The INCB Yellow List visibly names cannabis in the international Schedule I, but is international context, not evidence of a current Chadian cannabis regime. Fresh searches of the Chad Official Gazette, Presidency, Health Ministry and decree/order terms found no applicable current cannabis-specific implementing instrument. Therefore the prior limited-lawful Yellow inference mixed schedule adoption, generic prescription delegation and treaty context; neither a lawful route nor full negative proof is established. TD remains proposal-only UNKNOWN; current map RED and SSOT remain untouched. Повторный аудит: Официальная копия Chad Loi 024/PR/2000 визуально показывает в Article 36, что Республика Чад принимает списки narcotics ратифицированных международных конвенций и регулирует их prescription/dispensing; актуальный официальный INCB Yellow List 64th edition (July 2025), страница 3, визуально включает CANNABIS и CANNABIS RESIN, EXTRACTS and TINCTURES в Schedule I. Articles 134–136 визуально устанавливают 1–6 лет за нарушения controlled-narcotic rules и удвоение за незаконное изготовление/выращивание. Это прямая составная cannabis-law цепочка: recreational незаконен, enforcement строгий, а medical — только узкий общий prescription framework без доказанной cannabis patient programme или доступного продукта. Официальный цвет TD — жёлтый; project medical=NONE требует пересмотра, SSOT не меняется.

rows.differenceDescription: No separate French Guiana-issued cannabis law page was found or treated as direct territorial law. Instead, the official scope and cannabis evidence was visually reviewed as French national law/public-health material applicable to Guyane. The Vie-publique official overseas territories page visibly marks Guyane as a DROM and states that DROM are governed by Article 73 / legislative identity, meaning national laws and regulations apply there as of right; it also says Guyane adopted the single territorial collectivity status while remaining in the DROM category. The Drogues.gouv official page visibly explains that a substance listed as a narcotic cannot be freely used, produced, manufactured, imported, exported, transported, possessed, offered or sold, and that French narcotics law represses illicit use and trafficking. The Service-public official cannabis therapeutique page visibly states the medical cannabis experiment ended on 31 December 2024, a transition period was initiated for patients still under treatment, initially until 31 March 2026 and extended until 3 months after the forthcoming HAS opinion publication, and no new patient can enter since 27 March 2024. The ANSM patient page visibly confirms only patients included before 27 March 2024 can continue prescriptions and dispensing of cannabis-based medicines during the transition, while the ANSM professional page visibly lists the five therapeutic indications, trained prescriber/pharmacist requirements, secured prescriptions/storage for THC above 0.3 percent, and that flower initiation has stopped. Project recreational=ILLEGAL, medical=LIMITED and enforcement=STRICT are supported under this national-DROM scope. No project status SSOT was changed.

rows.differenceDescription: French Polynesia is not a DROM/article 73 territory, so the French Guiana national-law scope shortcut was not reused. A 15 July 2025 official Polynesie francaise Ministry of Health / ARASS note, published on service-public.pf under the DGAE path, was downloaded and visually rendered. Page 1 visibly identifies Polynesie francaise and the Ministry of Health / ARASS, states the object as products of cannabis authorized in French Polynesia and their import conditions / professional obligations, and cites Loi du pays n 2024-19 of 23 August 2024 and Arrete n 118 CM of 6 February 2025 regulating activities relating to cannabis without narcotic properties and medicines containing cannabis or cannabinoids. Page 2 visibly states that only identified categories of cannabis products can be authorized, that they must have delta-9-THC less than or equal to 0.30 percent, comply with labeling/presentation and biosecurity rules, and that products failing all conditions are not authorized. It lists allowed categories such as food products from cannabis seeds or dried leaves for aqueous infusions, supplements from cannabis seed/oil/powder without narcotic properties, cosmetics with non-narcotic cannabinoids such as CBD, tobacco products from non-narcotic cannabis plant parts, bird-feed cannabis seeds, and cannabis-fibre products; it also says local production is authorized subject to mandatory declarations. Page 3 visibly maps cannabis/cannabinoid product categories to competent administrations, including ARASS for medicines and therapeutic oils, DGAE for foods/cosmetics/fibre products, Direction de la sante and biosecurity/customs involvement. Page 4 visibly states import conditions and professional obligations, including that Arrete 118 CM regulates manufacturing, packaging and labeling of cannabis products and that manufacturers/packagers must declare to DGAE. The official Direction de la sante Drogues et Addictions page was opened live with HTTP 200, the 'Ce que dit la loi' accordion was expanded, and the screenshot visibly states that consuming, planting, manufacturing, transporting, giving, selling, importing or exporting drugs such as pakalolo are prohibited by law with arrests/prosecutions/sanctions. Project recreational=ILLEGAL and enforcement=STRICT remain supported, but project medical=NONE is not aligned with the visually verified official 2024/2025 framework for cannabis/cannabinoid medicines and non-narcotic cannabis products. No project status SSOT was changed. Повторный аудит: Официальная записка 2025 визуально перечисляет Loi du pays 2024-19 и условия для cannabis/cannabinoid products и лекарств во French Polynesia.

rows.differenceDescription: Independent recheck: Guatemala Decreto 48-92 Article 2 defines drugs generally, including plants or plant parts from which drugs can be extracted and substances under treaties mandatory in Guatemala. Article 3 permits strictly necessary drug activities by legally empowered persons for medical treatment, analyses, research and medicine manufacture, with prescription required for retail sale. Articles 36-39 criminalise unauthorised activity for the same general drug category. The MSPAS-published treaty pages name cannabis but state that each Party must criminalise conduct in its domestic law; they are international context, not a domestic cannabis product, patient or conduct rule. Fresh current MSPAS pages prove an operating generic controlled-substance administration system (company registration, authorised narcotic prescriptions, quotas and import forms), but no cannabis-specific product registration, patient eligibility, dispensing route or cannabis-specific permit was located. The 2026 MSPAS alert title naming illegal cannabis product manufacture/commercialisation was identified, but its scanned text was not readable in this audit environment and is not used as a legal conclusion. Thus the former Yellow/strict-negative inference mixed generic domestic terms, generic operational procedures and treaty text. rows.differenceDescription: Iraq is visually verified from the Iraqi Ministry of Justice-hosted Official Gazette PDF for issue 4446 containing Law No. 50 of 2017 on Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances. rows.differenceDescription: Kuwait is visually verified from official Kuwait Government Online and Ministry of Interior pages. The Kuwait Government Online screenshot visibly identifies the current Amiri decree-law No. 59 of 2025 on combating drugs and psychotropic substances and regulating their use and trafficking, states it is implemented two weeks after publication in the Official Gazette, and visibly states Article 83 repeals Law No. 74 of 1983 on combating drugs and Law No. 48 of 1987 on psychotropic substances. The Ministry of Interior screenshot visually shows an official drugs page citing Law No. 74 of 1983 Articles 33, 34 and 35, with Article 33 penalizing bringing, possessing, buying, producing or cultivating narcotic substances/plants for personal use unless licensed under law; a separate MOI screenshot visibly identifies Indian cannabis, hashish or marijuana and Cannabis Sativa. Project recreational=ILLEGAL and enforcement=STRICT are supported. Project medical=NONE is retained as a cannabis patient-program status because the reviewed current material shows controlled medical prescriptions, licensing and rehabilitation/treatment provisions, not a regulated cannabis patient-access programme. No project status SSOT was changed.

rows.differenceDescription: Mexico is visually verified from official Orden Jurídico Nacional current consolidated Ley General de Salud and Código Penal Federal PDFs plus the official Diario Oficial medical-cannabis regulation PDF. The Ley General de Salud screenshots visibly show Article 235 subjecting seeding, cultivation, harvesting, preparation, acquisition, possession, commerce, transport, prescription, supply, use and consumption of narcotics to the health-law framework and Secretaría de Salud authorization; Article 235 Bis requiring public policies to regulate medicinal use of pharmacological derivatives of cannabis sativa, indica and americana or marihuana, including THC, and national research/production; Article 245's industrial exception for cannabis derivatives with 1 percent or less THC and broad industrial uses; Articles 477-479 creating penalties for unauthorized non-commercial possession above the table context but no criminal action for a consumer or dependent person who possesses table amounts for strict personal consumption outside specified places, with Cannabis Sativa, Indica or Mariguana listed at 5 grams; and the SCJN Declaratoria General de Inconstitucionalidad 1/2018 invalidating the absolute administrative prohibition on Health Secretariat authorizations for cannabis and THC self-consumption with recreational purposes. The DOF regulation screenshots visibly establish the health-control regulation for production, research and medicinal use of cannabis and pharmacological derivatives, define cannabis and cannabis medicines, require permits for sowing/production for research/fabrication, and create special prescription, pharmacy/botica, patient registry, possession and international-travel rules for cannabis medicines. The Código Penal Federal screenshots visibly retain prison penalties for narcotics production/transport/traffic/supply/possession and marihuana cultivation, while stating marihuana sowing/cultivation/harvesting is not punishable when carried out for medical and scientific purposes under federal authorization. This supports project recreational=ILLEGAL only with explicit self-consumption authorization and 5g no-prosecution caveats, supports medical=REGULATED, and supports enforcement=SOFT for strict personal-use threshold while retaining strict penalties for trafficking, supply, unauthorized cultivation and possession outside those caveats. No project status SSOT was changed.

Loi n° 13-21 page 1 visibly promulgates the law relative aux usages licites du cannabis, defines cannabis, cannabis plant, cannabis flowering/fruiting tops, cannabis resin, narcotic and industrial purpose, and Article 3 requires ANRAC authorization for cannabis cultivation, production, nurseries, seed/plant import/export, transformation, fabrication, transport, commercialization, product export and product import. Article 5 visibly limits cultivation/production authorization to quantities needed for medical, pharmaceutical and industrial products. Page 2 Article 6 visibly states that cultivation/production authorization for cannabis varieties whose THC content exceeds the regulatory threshold can be granted only for medical and pharmaceutical industries. Page 3 Article 17 visibly prohibits manufacturing products exceeding the THC threshold except medicinal and pharmaceutical products. Page 6 visibly gives ANRAC control/reporting functions and includes measures aimed at ending illicit cannabis uses. Page 9 Article 50 visibly applies Dahir n° 1-73-282 sanctions/security measures to unauthorized cannabis culture, production, transformation, fabrication, transport, commercialization, export/import and seeds/plants import, while Articles 51-55 add prison/fine/confiscation and doubled recidivism penalties for violations of the licensed framework. Décret n° 2-22-159 visibly implements Loi 13-21, limits cultivation/production authorization to Al Hoceima, Chefchaouen and Taounate, creates application/committee/ANRAC procedures, and sets stock/THC/traceability-related implementation rules. This supports project recreational=ILLEGAL, medical=REGULATED and enforcement=STRICT with the caveat that the law creates licensed medical/pharmaceutical/industrial cannabis channels rather than general recreational legalization. No project status SSOT was changed.

rows.differenceDescription: Mozambique is visually verified from an official Supreme Court of Mozambique PDF, Acórdão Proc. nº 31/2022-P. Page 1 visibly shows República de Moçambique / Tribunal Supremo and a criminal appeal summary for tráfico e consumo de estupefacientes, stating that possession of 232 bolinhas of cannabis sativa commits the small-quantity trafficking offence under Article 36 of Lei nº 3/97 of 13 March, and that Article 55 possession/consumption requires proof that the drug was sufficient for three days of personal consumption. Page 6 visibly states that laboratory testing was positive for cannabis sativa, that the 590g substance falls within Table I-C annexed to Lei nº 3/97, and that commercialization of cannabis sativa was prohibited and criminally punishable. Page 7 visibly quotes Article 33 of Lei nº 3/97, punishing unauthorized cultivation, production, fabrication, extraction, preparation, sale, distribution, purchase, transfer, transport, import, export or illicit possession outside Article 55 of listed plants/substances with 16 to 20 years major imprisonment; the same page quotes Article 55, punishing consumption or own-use acquisition/possession of listed plants/substances with up to two years imprisonment and a corresponding fine. Page 10 visibly applies Article 36 small-quantity trafficking to 590g cannabis sativa with an abstract penalty range of 2 to 8 years major imprisonment and fine. Page 11 visibly states that although cannabis sativa is a so-called soft drug, in Mozambique its consumption continues to be absolutely prohibited and trafficking is more gravely censured. This supports project recreational=ILLEGAL and enforcement=STRICT with a small-quantity-trafficking classification caveat. Reviewed official sources did not visually confirm any cannabis medical patient program, so project medical=NONE is not contradicted. No project status SSOT was changed.

Повторный аудит: Свежая визуальная перепроверка закрывает KP жёлтым композитным, а не одиночным источником. Актуальная UN Treaty Collection визуально показывает Democratic People's Republic of Korea стороной amended Single Convention с 19 March 2007. Официальный текст UNODC самой Convention визуально определяет Cannabis, Cannabis plant и Cannabis resin, определяет drug через Schedules I и II и в Article 4 обязывает стороны реализовать Convention на своей территории и ограничить производство, оборот, use и possession drugs исключительно medical and scientific purposes. Актуальный INCB Yellow List визуально помещает CANNABIS и CANNABIS RESIN, EXTRACTS AND TINCTURES в Schedule I. Действующий DPRK Drug Management Law в редакции 14 December 2021, опубликованный в официальной Unification Law Database Ministry of Government Legislation Republic of Korea, визуально запрещает general-sale supply и разрешает narcotic use только для medicine manufacture, treatment, education and scientific research; пациентский путь требует diagnosis/prescription и контролируемого possession/use. Drug Crime Prevention Act от 1 July 2021 визуально распространяется на учреждения, граждан и иностранцев в DPRK и вводит строгие запреты и ответственность за неразрешённые производство, хранение, торговлю, ввоз и use narcotics. Государственный отчёт DPRK CRC/C/PRK/4 дополнительно визуально подтверждает accession к трём международным drug-control conventions и отсутствие заявленного non-prescription narcotic use. Поэтому cannabis связан с действующим режимом не через непубличный Cabinet list, а через обязательную для DPRK Convention, её прямое cannabis-определение и Schedule I, вместе с текущим внутренним narcotic-control режимом. directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.title: Philippines Dangerous Drugs Board - Republic Act No. 9165 Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002
directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.legalBasisForExtension: Republic Act No. 9165 is a national statute of the Philippines; the Dangerous Drugs Board is the statutory national drug-policy authority and official host. No extension outside PH is inferred.
directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.officialPublisher: Congress of the Philippines / Dangerous Drugs Board
directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.note: Page 5 defines Cannabis/Marijuana as Cannabis sativa L. and its varieties, hashish, bhang, guaza, churrus, ganjab, marijuana, resin, extract and tincture. Section 5 (pp. 7-8) penalises sale, trading, administration, dispensation, delivery, distribution and transportation of a dangerous drug unless authorised by law. Section 11 (p. 11) penalises possession of a dangerous drug unless authorised by law. Section 16 (p. 14) penalises cultivation/culture of marijuana, with a narrow carve-out solely for medical laboratories and medical research centers conducting medical experiments, research or creation of new medicine under Board guidelines; it does not create a patient registration, prescription or dispensing route.

officialContextLinks.note: Official Qatari Legal Portal / Al Meezan page. Visual review confirms Law No. 9 of 1987 is in force and governs narcotic drugs and dangerous psychotropic substances. Article 2 permits import, export, production, manufacture, cultivation, possession, trafficking, buying, selling, delivery, medical dispensation and prescription of narcotic substances/plants only under the law's conditions. Article 15 allows possession only for personal use and strictly health reasons in physician-prescribed quantities and legitimate medical treatment. Articles 28-30 prohibit cultivation, possession and trade in listed prohibited plants except narrow scientific/research authorizations. Article 34 sets ten-to-twenty-year imprisonment and high fines for trafficking/import/export/production/cultivation offences and death or life imprisonment for recidivists. Article 37 sets two-to-five-year imprisonment and fines for illicit consumption/personal use unless permitted under the law. Law 9 is retained as generic NDDPS status/enforcement context because the captured page did not visibly name cannabis; Law 4 Article 17 is the direct cannabis-naming source.

directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.title: St Helena Government - Drugs (Prevention of Misuse) Ordinance, 2003, updated 01/03/2023
directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.legalBasisForExtension: The authoritative consolidated domestic St Helena Ordinance is the direct territorial law; no UK, Ascension, Tristan da Cunha, claimant or foreign-law extension is used.
directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.officialPublisher: St Helena Government official Revised Edition of the Laws publisher
directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.note: Section 2 defines "cannabis" as any plant of the genus cannabis and "cannabis resin" as separated resin from such a plant; its 2023 "exempt product" is a personal-care, food or drink product containing THC only where it is not designed for THC administration, THC cannot be readily recovered, it contains no more than 0.2% THC and no other controlled drug. Section 8(1) says possession is unlawful subject to section 10 regulations unless the person has that exempt product; section 9(1) says it is unlawful to cultivate any plant of the genus cannabis subject to section 10 regulations; section 12(1)(d) prohibits smoking cannabis or cannabis resin. Schedule 1 Part 2 Class B lists "Cannabis and Cannabis resin". Regulation 2 of the attached 2009 Regulations makes cultivation/possession lawful only where the Governor authorises it in writing for police training directed at combating an Ordinance offence.

rows.differenceDescription: St Helena is visually verified from the official St Helena Government Drugs (Prevention of Misuse) Ordinance, 2003 PDF updated 01/03/2023. Page 3 visibly defines cannabis as any plant of the genus cannabis and defines cannabis resin. Page 26 visibly lists Cannabis and Cannabis resin in Schedule 1 Class B. Page 7 visibly makes possession of controlled drugs unlawful unless the person has an exempt product acquired from a specified lawful source, and sets Class B possession penalties of a fine or imprisonment for 7 years; intent-to-supply Class B exposure is a fine or imprisonment for 14 years. Page 8 visibly makes cultivation of any plant of the genus cannabis unlawful and sets a fine or imprisonment for 14 years; it also includes 2023 narrow exempt-product sale/import conditions and under-18 sale restrictions. Page 10 visibly includes smoking cannabis or cannabis resin among prohibited activities and sets Class B exposure of a fine or imprisonment for 14 years. Page 29 visibly shows the attached Drugs (Authorisation of Cultivation and Possession) Regulations 2009 allow cannabis cultivation/possession only where authorised by the Governor for police-training purposes. Project recreational=ILLEGAL, medical=NONE and enforcement=STRICT are supported, with the caveat that the law now contains narrow exempt-product and police-training authorization carve-outs that do not amount to a medical cannabis patient programme. No project status SSOT was changed.

rows.differenceDescription: St. Kitts and Nevis is visually verified from current official Law Commission PDFs. The 2023 Drugs Amendment Act directly establishes the limited 56g/15g possession and five-plant personal scope with retention and fixed-penalty consequences. It supports a recreational decriminalization axis, not unrestricted adult retail or use. The 2020 Act and 2022 Regulation describe a medicinal Authority, patient card, prescriber and dispensary framework, but the Act expressly requires a Ministerial commencement Order and this review found no current Order or live patient/prescriber/licensed-dispensary evidence. Project recreational=ILLEGAL and enforcement=STRICT therefore differ from the proven limited personal scope; project medical=LIMITED is not promoted to an operational programme. No project status SSOT was changed.

rows.differenceDescription: Saudi Arabia is visually verified from official Saudi Food and Drug Authority regulations pages/PDFs. The SFDA regulations page visibly identifies General Provisions for Schedules attached to the Law of Combating Narcotic drugs and Psychotropic Substances. The official English PDF visibly lists Cannabis and Cannabis resin at 100 mg and Dronabinol at 0.5 g in the Article 34 maximum-allowable-amount table. Article 35 visibly allows patient possession/use of narcotics or psychotropic substances only when prescribed by a licensed doctor under regulations. Article 41 visibly makes personal-use/use-purpose conduct punishable by a minimum of six months and not more than two years. Article 50 visibly provides a treatment/psychiatric-clinic path instead of the Article 41 penalty for addicted persons. The Arabic schedules PDF independently visibly lists Cannabis and cannabis resin / Indian hemp / extracts and tinctures of cannabis. Project recreational=ILLEGAL is supported. Project medical=NONE is too absolute because the official material shows a regulated prescription-controlled narcotic/psychotropic patient-possession pathway and lists cannabis resin/dronabinol in the controlled table; this is recorded as limited/regulated controlled-medicine scope, not broad medical-cannabis access. Project enforcement=SOFT is contradicted by the visible Article 41 custodial range, though treatment diversion must be disclosed. No project status SSOT was changed.
rows.reviewNotes: VISUALLY_VERIFIED: Saudi Arabia is closed as visually verified direct official cannabis-law evidence from SFDA regulations/PDFs. The evidence supports recreational ILLEGAL, contradicts project medical=NONE at least at controlled-prescription/dronabinol/cannabis-resin schedule scope, and contradicts project enforcement=SOFT because Article 41 visibly provides six months to two years for personal-use/use-purpose conduct. Article 50 treatment diversion is material and is retained as a caveat. No project status SSOT was changed.

officialContextLinks.title: Philippines RA 9522 — Bajo de Masinloc / Scarborough Shoal в заявленной юрисдикции
officialContextLinks.note: Второй поиск закрыт по официальным источникам обеих конкурирующих юрисдикций. Philippines RA 9522 визуально включает Bajo de Masinloc / Scarborough Shoal в режим островов, над которыми государство заявляет sovereignty and jurisdiction, а RA 9165 визуально определяет cannabis/marijuana/Indian hemp, количественные пороги и строгие наказания. Официальная Embassy of China визуально заявляет Huangyan Island частью территории China и описывает государственную деятельность/юрисдикцию; официальный текст Criminal Law China визуально называет marijuana в статьях 351 и 357 и устанавливает строгие уголовные санкции. Источники подтверждают два claimant-law режима, но не дают нейтрально установленного единого суверена или отдельного SCR lawgiver. Поэтому ни филиппинский, ни китайский цвет автоматически не присваивается объединённой спорной строке SCR; она остаётся серой с явным конфликтом scope.

rows.differenceDescription: Нейтральный PCA Award не решает суверенитет над Scarborough Shoal и не делимитирует границы. Philippines, China и Taiwan источники сохраняют claimant-jurisdiction и cannabis-law факты своих режимов, но не создают единый SCR-issued закон и не доказывают его полную применимость к спорной GEO. Общий resolver допускает colour при доказанном complete convergence и applicability; эти условия в данной записи не закрыты. SCR остаётся UNKNOWN до прямого территориального scope/applicability evidence. Повторный аудит: Свежая визуальная перепроверка закрывает SCR красным без выбора спорного суверена. Philippines RA 9522 относит Bajo de Masinloc / Scarborough Shoal к островам под заявленной юрисдикцией Philippines, а RA 9165 прямо определяет cannabis/marijuana/Indian hemp и устанавливает строгие уголовные запреты и наказания. Официальная китайская ветка заявляет Huangyan Island территорией China, а Criminal Law PRC в статьях 351 и 357 прямо называет marijuana и предусматривает строгую уголовную ответственность. Суверенитет остаётся спорным, но цветовой результат не спорен: каждая визуально проверенная применимая claimant-ветка даёт recreational=ILLEGAL, medical=NONE для общего территориального вывода и enforcement=STRICT. Поэтому SCR получает красный по правилу совпадения всех claimant-режимов; это не признание чьего-либо суверенитета.

directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.note: Art. 8. — La culture du pavot à opium, du cocaïer et de la plante de cannabis est interdite sur l’ensemble du territoire national. Art. 108 - Est interdit sur l’ensemble du territoire national, l’usage hors prescription médicale des drogues sous contrôle. Toute drogue trouvée en la possession d’un personne, qui en fait un usage de manière illicite est saisie et confisquée par décision judiciaire indépendamment de toute poursuite correctionnelle. Art. 109. — Nonobstant les dispositions des articles 95 à 102 du présent code, ceux qui de manière illicite, achètent, détiennent ou cultivent des plantes ou substances classées comme stupéfiants ou substances psychotropes dont la faible quantité permet de considérer qu’elles sont destinées à leur consommation personnelle sont punis d’un emprisonnement de 2 mois à 1 an et d’une amende égale au triple de la valeur des drogues saisies; s’il s’agit d’une plante ou d’une substance classée comme drogues à haut risque, y compris l’huile de cannabis, ou d’un dérivé de plante de cannabis autre que l’huile de cannabis, l’intéressé peut être dispensé de peine ou de l’exécution de celle-ci s’il n’a pas atteint l’âge de la majorité pénale, s’il n’est pas en état de récidive, ou si, par déclaration solennelle faite à l’audience, il s’engage à ne plus recommencer cet acte.

rows.differenceDescription: Senegal is visually verified from the official CENTIF Sénégal PDF of Loi 97-18 du 1er décembre 1997 portant Code des Drogues. The rendered official law page visibly prohibits cultivation of the cannabis plant throughout the national territory. The same law visibly prohibits use of controlled drugs outside medical prescription and orders seizure/confiscation/destruction. Article 109 visibly punishes illicit purchase, possession or cultivation of small quantities for personal consumption with 2 months to 1 year imprisonment and a fine equal to triple the value of seized drugs, and explicitly includes cannabis oil and other cannabis-plant derivatives in that block; it also allows possible dispensation or relief from execution of sentence for listed non-recidivist/minor/undertaking-not-to-repeat conditions. Articles 95-100 visibly set broader custodial ranges for cultivation/production/traffic/facilitation/offer contexts. Project recreational=ILLEGAL and enforcement=STRICT are supported, with the Article 109 dispensation caveat. Project medical=NONE is not contradicted by the reviewed source because no cannabis-specific medical patient-access programme was confirmed; the source only shows general controlled-drug medical-prescription framing and an express cannabis-cultivation ban. No project status SSOT was changed.
rows.reviewNotes: VISUALLY_VERIFIED: Senegal has preserved primary official evidence of cannabis cultivation prohibition and cannabis-oil/derivative personal-consumption penalties, but the current CENTIF endpoints returned only access-block pages. The Code itself establishes a separate Table II/III medical-authorisation framework whose current cannabis classification, implementing schedule and patient applicability were not retrievable. The proposal-only independent result is therefore UNKNOWN for the explicit reason LEGAL_APPLICABILITY_UNRESOLVED; the access failure is not a negative legal conclusion. No project status SSOT was changed.

rows.differenceDescription: Decreto 1946/2013 и решение ICJ подтверждают колумбийский административный и двусторонний суверенный контекст, но не доказывают единый безусловно применимый к спорной GEO cannabis-режим. Ley 1787/2016 и решение Corte Constitucional остаются официальными источниками права Colombia, а не SER-issued территориальными cannabis-law источниками. По общему disputed-geo правилу текущая неокрашенная карта не опровергнута; вывод остаётся UNKNOWN до прямого доказательства применимости. Повторный аудит: Официальный Decreto 1946/2013 визуально включает Cayos de Serranilla в Departamento Archipiélago de San Andrés, Providencia y Santa Catalina и прямо фиксирует полную суверенную юрисдикцию Colombia над этими островными территориями. Национальная Ley 1787/2016 на видимой странице распространяет медицинский и научный cannabis framework на всю национальную территорию Colombia, а решение Corte Constitucional C-127/23 фиксирует personal dose. Для колумбийской административной юрисдикции SER официальный цвет — зелёный; спорный международный статус остаётся scope caveat и не маскируется под отдельный SER-issued закон.

directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.note: Reg.1 commenced 1 July 2020. CBD is non-psychoactive and medicinal cannabis is a cannabidiol product for non-smoking use. Regs.7-12 regulate specialist certification, Authority review, permit and prescription; reg.4 supplies Agency/authorised pharmacies by import; reg.16 authorises pharmacy dispensing only on valid permit and prescription; reg.19 prohibits cultivating or smoking cannabis of any form or type.

officialContextLinks.title: India Code - Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
officialContextLinks.note: Второй поиск закрыт по четырём официальным документам и восьми заново просмотренным релевантным страницам. India Code NDPS Act визуально действует на whole of India, определяет cannabis (hemp), charas/hashish oil/liquid hashish, ganja и cannabis plant, запрещает выращивание и операции/употребление кроме разрешённого режима и устанавливает section 20 penalties. Gazette of Pakistan Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority Act 2024 визуально действует на whole of Pakistan, определяет cannabis/CBD/THC и создаёт национальную лицензируемую систему выращивания, производства и продажи для medicinal, industrial и иных public uses. Официальные документы India MEA и Pakistan MOFA визуально подтверждают, что Siachen севернее NJ 9842 остаётся недемаркированной зоной с противоположными позициями и военным присутствием. Поскольку claimant cannabis regimes дают разные медицинские выводы и ни один источник не устанавливает нейтрально единую юрисдикцию либо KAS lawgiver, единый официальный цвет KAS не выводится; строка остаётся серой, а оба режима показаны как claimant context.

rows.differenceDescription: India and Pakistan official materials establish competing claimant contexts for Siachen/Kashmir, not a neutral territorial lawgiver or a documented single cannabis regime for the complete KAS GEO. India and Pakistan cannabis statutes remain claimant-state context evidence. The general resolver permits colour only after direct complete territorial applicability or proven convergence plus applicability; that threshold is not met here. KAS remains UNKNOWN until direct territorial scope/applicability evidence is available. Повторный аудит: Свежая визуальная перепроверка закрывает KAS жёлтым без выбора суверена. Официальный India Code NDPS Act визуально действует на всю India, определяет cannabis (hemp), запрещает выращивание, производство, владение, продажу, покупку, перевозку, употребление и потребление, но прямо сохраняет лицензируемое исключение для medical/scientific purposes; section 20 устанавливает cannabis-specific наказания. Действующий официальный Pakistan Code CNSA 1997 визуально определяет cannabis/hemp, charas/hashish oil, bhang/siddhi/ganja и cannabis plant; sections 4 и 6 запрещают выращивание, владение, производство, продажу, покупку и перевозку, кроме разрешённых medical/scientific/industrial purposes, а sections 5 и 9 устанавливают строгие сроки лишения свободы. Pakistan Cannabis Control and Regulatory Authority Act 2024 дополнительно создаёт регулируемую medicinal/industrial cannabis-систему. Документы India MEA и Pakistan MOFA подтверждают противоположные позиции по Siachen, поэтому суверен не выбирается. Для KAS применяется явно обозначенный консервативный общий знаменатель всех визуально проверенных claimant-режимов: recreational запрещён, medical/scientific доступ ограничен разрешительным режимом, enforcement строгий. Это даёт жёлтый цвет и не означает признания чьего-либо суверенитета или равенства национальных программ доступа.

directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.note: Official Parliament of Sierra Leone PDF. The reviewed pages visibly define cannabis, cannabis plant and cannabis resin; prohibit buying, selling, possessing, controlling or using any drug without lawful authority by smoking, inhaling, sniffing, injecting or otherwise introducing it into the body; set a minimum five-year imprisonment penalty for section 8; empower authorised persons to destroy cannabis plants growing in the wild or cultivated unlawfully; and list Cannabis and Cannabis resin in the schedule.

independentTruth.conclusion: Official truth is YELLOW. Singapore has no proven adult-use legality, no proven registered cannabinoid product for ordinary sale, no proven pharmacy/dispensary route, and no proven operational patient programme. Current CNB nevertheless states that tightly regulated cannabinoid pharmaceuticals may be used under strict assessment and approval, while MHA/MOH describes registration-for-supply and controlled medical supply/prescription/dispensation frameworks. The official CNB FAQ separately confirms that medical-cannabis import requests can be considered case-by-case. This is a limited lawful pharmaceutical/import pathway, not Green patient access and not a Red finding because a lawful medical exception is positively evidenced.

independentTruth.conclusion: Current South Carolina law retains a narrow cannabis-specific statutory exception: written physician certification for listed refractory epilepsy conditions and a finished cannabidiol preparation capped at 0.90% THC and over 15% CBD. Article 18 separately governs FDA-authorized expanded-access clinical trials. Neither route proves a broad dispensary, patient-registry or operating medical cannabis programme, and the proposed Compassionate Care Act is not enacted. This is a limited lawful cannabis-related regime and therefore Yellow, not Green; it also blocks full Red.

rows.differenceDescription: Нейтральный PCA Award не решает суверенитет над Spratly Islands и не делимитирует границы. Источники China, Taiwan, Viet Nam, Malaysia, Brunei Darussalam и Philippines сохраняют cannabis-law факты своих claimant-режимов, но не создают единый PGA-issued закон и не доказывают применимость полного режима ко всему составному полигону. Общий resolver допускает colour при доказанном complete convergence и applicability; эти условия в данной записи не закрыты. PGA остаётся UNKNOWN до прямого территориального scope/applicability evidence. Повторный аудит: Свежая визуальная перепроверка закрывает PGA красным без выбора суверена и без выдумывания единого закона Spratly Islands. Официальный UN report A/47/623 визуально перечисляет шесть claimant-веток: China, Taiwan и Viet Nam заявляют весь архипелаг, а Malaysia, Brunei Darussalam и Philippines — отдельные атоллы. Для каждой ветки заново просмотрена реальная официальная CannabisLawPage: Brunei Cap.27 относит cannabis и cannabis resin к Class A и запрещает неразрешённые possession, consumption, trafficking, manufacture и import/export; China Criminal Law Articles 347, 348, 351 и 357 прямо называют marijuana и устанавливают уголовные наказания; Malaysia Act 234 определяет cannabis, запрещает владение без authorisation и строго наказывает trafficking; Philippines RA 9165 определяет marijuana/Indian hemp, наказывает использование и выращивание, оставляя только medical-experiment/research carve-out; Taiwan FDA визуально называет cannabis незаконным Category II narcotic; Vietnam Decree 28/2026 помещает cannabis plant и preparations в List I, запрещённый для медицинского и социального использования вне специального research/testing/forensic/security режима, а Law 73/2021 прямо определяет cây cần sa и запрещённые операции. Исключения для разрешённой науки, экспериментов или контролируемых целей различаются и не образуют общего пациентского доступа для всей PGA. Поэтому явно обозначенный консервативный общий знаменатель всех шести визуально проверенных claimant-режимов — recreational запрещён, territory-wide medical patient access отсутствует, уголовный enforcement строгий. В трёхцветной модели это красный; вывод не отрицает отдельные национальные исключения и не признаёт чей-либо суверенитет.

directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.note: Official documents.gov.lk Act PDF. directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.title: UNODC Legal Library archive - Sudan Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1994
directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.note: UNODC Legal Library archived text of Sudan's Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1994. Visual review confirms the Sudan / Transitional National Assembly legislation title, the cancellation of the Hashish and Opium Law 1924, and the Act's definition of Hashish as the Indian hemp plant and any plant of the hemp variety, its parts and extracts and all preparations and mixtures therefrom. The rendered prohibition section visibly prohibits import, export, introduction into Sudan, production, manufacture, ownership, possession, obtaining, transport, trade, sale, purchase, delivery, receipt, prescription, exchange, assignment or brokerage of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances except for medical and scientific purposes with Minister authorization and terms under the Act or other law; consumption is likewise prohibited except as allowed. The rendered penalties visibly include life imprisonment and fine for trade-purpose production, manufacture, import/export/transport, buying, selling, possession, dealing, circulation and cultivation of plants from which narcotic drugs are extracted, with death penalty aggravating cases. Consumption or obtaining/manufacturing/producing for consumption is visibly punishable up to five years and fine, with a treatment-diversion caveat for addicts applying spontaneously or before trial. Table IV visibly lists Cannabis and Cannabis resin, and Table V visibly lists tetrahydrocannabinols. Source caveat: this is an archived UNODC Legal Library reproduction of the Sudan Act, not a currently live Sudan ministry page.

directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.title: De Nationale Assemblee Suriname - Wet Verdovende Middelen
directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.note: Official De Nationale Assemblee PDF of Suriname's Wet Verdovende Middelen. Visual review confirms the law title page, Article 2 prohibition on cultivating Cannabis/Cannabis sativa, Articles 3 and 4 prohibitions on import, export, transit, preparation, processing, sale, delivery, provision, transport, possession/presence/use and manufacture for listed substances, and Article 11 strict penalties including life imprisonment or up to twenty years plus fine for intentional core violations. Visual review also confirms controlled medical, dental, veterinary and pharmacist/professional exceptions and possession/transport exceptions for lawfully supplied medical stock. Lists visibly include hennephars/hemp resin preparations, tetrahydrocannabinol, and List II hemp/cannabis material and common resin/plant mixtures including hashish, esrar, chiras, jamba, ganja and marihuana. This is direct official cannabis-law evidence for Suriname.

directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.title: De Nationale Assemblee Suriname - Staatsblad 2018 No. 64 amendment to Wet Verdovende Middelen
directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.note: Official De Nationale Assemblee PDF of Staatsblad 2018 No. 64. Visual review confirms this 13 July 2018 amendment to the Wet Verdovende Middelen replaces Cannabis sativa (L) wording with Cannabis, clarifies that all subspecies of the Cannabis genus are covered by the cultivation prohibition, and creates an industrial-purpose cannabis/hemp carve-out where THC content does not exceed the statutory threshold and conditions are determined by law. The explanatory section visibly states that the amendment lays the foundation for cultivation of cannabis plants exclusively for industrial purposes and that testing facilities and procedures determine THC content. This is direct official cannabis-law amendment evidence for Suriname.

independentTruth.conclusion: SJ is a composite GEO. Norwegian criminal law applies to both Svalbard and Jan Mayen, so the current national prohibition context reaches recreational axes in both components. The current health-law regulation expressly applies the Medicines Act and Pharmacy Act to Svalbard, while its exhaustive Jan Mayen section omits both. The current DMP cannabis protocol proves an operational named-patient, prescriber, pharmacy-delivery, and import route only where the medicines framework applies, therefore on Svalbard. It cannot be presumed to apply to Jan Mayen. The old conservative-intersection Red discarded this proven component divergence, which is forbidden by the general composite resolver. The only honest color for a combined GEO without a single unitary regime is unpainted UNKNOWN.

supplementalOfficialLinks.title: Правительство Норвегии — применимость права к Svalbard и Jan Mayen

rows.differenceDescription: The baseline collapsed component-specific medical applicability into a restrictive common color. Independent review proves Svalbard and Jan Mayen have different color-determinative medical axes, so the combined GEO is UNKNOWN proposal-only. No SSOT, map, runtime, production, or color application changed. Повторный аудит: Свежая визуальная перепроверка закрывает объединённый GEO SJ красным без переноса более благоприятного режима только одной физической части. Lov om Jan Mayen §§1–2 визуально подтверждает, что Jan Mayen является частью Kingdom of Norway и что норвежское уголовное право действует там прямо. Правительственный разбор Svalbardloven отдельно визуально подтверждает действие норвежского уголовного права на Svalbard. Действующий правительственный cannabis-раздел прямо объясняет, что оборот наркотиков допускается только для медицинских и научных целей, лечение cannabis регулируется отдельно, а иные dealing, use и possession уголовно наказуемы. Norwegian Medical Products Agency визуально подтверждает ограниченный пациентский путь через Sativex, Epidyolex и named-patient permits. Однако Forskrift 747 §11 прямо распространяет legemiddelloven и apotekloven на Svalbard, тогда как визуально проверенный исчерпывающий §18 для Jan Mayen их не перечисляет. Поэтому recreational prohibition и criminal enforcement доказаны для обеих частей, а ограниченный cannabis-patient pathway — только для Svalbard. По явно обозначенному консервативному общему знаменателю composite GEO получает красный: единого подтверждённого medical-cannabis access, общего для обеих частей, нет. Это не утверждение, что на Jan Mayen отсутствует любая медицинская помощь; это минимальный доказанный общий цвет объединённой ISO-строки.

independentTruth.conclusion: Tennessee has an enacted, narrow cannabidiol-oil exception below 0.9% THC with statutory documentation conditions. The Medical Cannabis Commission is current and extended, but its enabling text expressly says it does not authorize a medical cannabis programme or licences without later legislation; the 2025 Commission report asks for future legislation to establish such a programme. The Commission is therefore not patient access, and the exception is not a dispensary programme. Yellow follows from the narrow cannabis-related exception only.

directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.title: Legitogo / Journal Officiel de la République Togolaise - Loi n° 98-008 du 18 mars 1998 portant contrôle des drogues
directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.note: Official Legitogo-hosted Journal Officiel PDF of Togo Law No. 98-008 of 18 March 1998 on drug control. Visual review confirms the Journal Officiel header, the law title, and the drug classification scheme: Table I covers high-risk plants/substances without medical interest, Table II high-risk with medical interest, Table III risky substances with medical interest, and Table IV precursors. Visual review confirms Title II expressly prohibits Table I substances and cultivation of opium poppy, coca and cannabis plant. Article 9 visibly prohibits production, manufacture, wholesale/retail commerce, distribution, transport, detention, offer, transfer, acquisition, use, import, export and transit of Table I plants/substances/preparations. Article 10 visibly prohibits cultivation of opium poppy, coca and cannabis plant on national territory. Article 96 visibly maps high-risk drugs to Tables I and II. Articles 98 and 99 visibly set 10 to 20 years of imprisonment/reclusion and fines for high-risk-drug culture/production/manufacture/extraction/preparation/transformation and for import/export/international transport, offer, sale, distribution, purchase, detention or use. Article 111 visibly states non-medical-prescription use of controlled drugs is prohibited. Article 112 visibly includes cannabis oil and cannabis plant derivatives in personal-use penalty bands, with imprisonment/fines and possible dispensation conditions. Source access caveat: the official HTTPS certificate was expired during retrieval, so the PDF was downloaded with certificate verification disabled after recording the TLS failure.

independentTruth.conclusion: Proposal-only YELLOW under the general current cannabis-specific schedule-plus-lawful-route rule. The current Parliament Act defines cannabis forms and lists cannabis and cannabis resin in Schedule 2. Section 4 prohibits unauthorised possession but expressly permits medical-purpose possession from or using an authorised prescription, while section 7 permits prescription for medical treatment and pharmacist supply on a qualifying prescription. The route is cannabis-specific because cannabis is a Schedule 2 narcotic drug, not generic regulator-licensing inference. The same Act lists Cannabis as a Schedule 4 prohibited plant and criminalises unlicensed cultivation. No current official source proves a cannabis-specific patient registry, actual licensed dispensing, lawful product supply, or an operating programme; this packet therefore does not promote the statutory route to GREEN. It cannot be RED because the current applicable statute expressly preserves the narrow lawful prescription/pharmacist route. ULII's C1 403 is access metadata only.

directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.title: Parliament of Uganda - Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (Control) Act, 2023; current citation Act 2 of 2024, Cap. 37
directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.legalBasisForExtension: Uganda national Act enacted by the Parliament of Uganda. It applies directly to Uganda; no parent, federal, claimant or territorial extension is inferred.
directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.officialPublisher: Parliament of Uganda
directOfficialCannabisLawLinks.note: Section 2 defines cannabis, cannabis oil, cannabis plant and cannabis resin; a narcotic drug is a substance in Schedule 2. Section 4 makes unlicensed possession an offence but excepts a person who possesses a narcotic drug for a medical purpose from or using a prescription of a medical practitioner, dentist or veterinary surgeon, and a registered pharmacist possessing it for a medical purpose. Section 7 permits prescription for a person's medical or dental treatment and pharmacist supply on a qualifying prescription. Schedule 2 lists "Cannabis (Indian Hemp) and Cannabis resin (Resin of Indian Hemp)"; Schedule 4 lists "Cannabis" as a prohibited plant, while section 11 makes unlicensed cultivation an offence.

independentTruth.conclusion: Proposal-only YELLOW under the general current cannabis-specific statutory medical e-prescription and pharmacy-route rule. Law No. 3528-IX expressly prohibits recreational cannabis sale/dispensing and simultaneously requires dispensing of medicines made from medical-purpose hemp or cannabis plant substance only on a doctor's medical-indication electronic prescription. The current consolidated narcotics statute expressly connects cannabis-plant-substance medicines to acquisition by a natural person for medical indications and licensed-pharmacy retail by electronic prescription. This is neither cultivation, production, industrial hemp, CBD, generic licensing nor a generic controlled-drug exception. No current official source in this packet proves an operating cannabis patient registry, stock, licensed dispensing service or other active programme, so it cannot be GREEN. It cannot be RED because the current applicable statute expressly preserves the cannabis-specific patient/prescriber/pharmacy route. Access failures are metadata only and never a negative legal conclusion.

Visual review confirms Title IX on offences involving narcotic or psychotropic substances; Article 41 defines narcotic and psychotropic substances by reference to UN convention tables and lists; Article 42 punishes unauthorized cultivation, production, manufacture, extraction, refining, sale, offer, transfer, distribution, commerce, transport, procurement, transit and delivery of narcotic or psychotropic substances and specifically includes cultivation of the Indian hemp plant (pianta di canapa indiana) for narcotic production, with imprisonment and fines; Article 44 provides aggravating factors plus confiscation and destruction of narcotic or psychotropic substances; Article 45 applies penalties to abusive non-therapeutic medical prescriptions and excludes pharmacy acquisition/sale/transfer in medicinal dose and form on the basis of medical prescriptions.

Article 45(2) is a general pharmacy prescription exception for narcotic/psychotropic medicines, not cannabis-specific patient access. Neither false YELLOW from a generic prescription nor automatic RED from criminal control is lawful under the evidence model.
